before.description: ISO 8601 cursor; returns messages created before this time.

limit.description: Max messages to return; default 30, max 100.

message_id.description: Exact persisted message ID, e.g. from search_memory source_refs.

session_id.description: Session to read; defaults to the current session.

platform.description: Channel platform filter (e.g. telegram, feishu); all when omitted.

type.description: Session type: chat or schedule; all when omitted.

contact_id.description: Filter by sender channel identity ID.

end_time.description: ISO 8601; only messages created at or before this time.

limit.description: Max messages to return; default 50, max 200.

start_time.description: ISO 8601; only messages created at or after this time.
